name: Xeris Biopharma Holdings, Inc.
summary: Xeris Biopharma Holdings, Inc., a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company, engages in developing and commercializing therapies for chronic endocrine and neurological diseases in Illinois. It offers Gvoke, a ready-to-use liquid-stable glucagon for the treatment of severe hypoglycemia in pediatric and adult patients; Keveyis, a therapy for the treatment of hyperkalemic, hypokalemic, and related variants of primary periodic paralysis; and Recorlev, a cortisol synthesis inhibitor for the treatment of endogenous hypercortisolemia in adult patients with Cushing's syndrome.
